meta.name: sentencepiece
meta.description: Language-independent tokenizer treating text as raw Unicode. Supports BPE and Unigram algorithms. Fast (50k sentences/sec), lightweight (6MB memory), deterministic vocabulary. Used by T5, ALBERT, XLNet, mBART. Train on raw text without pre-tokenization. Use when you need multilingual support, CJK languages, or reproducible tokenization.

copy.tagline: 训练自定义分词器，处理多语言文本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为多语言或CJK文本训练高效分词器
copy.tagline_en: Train custom tokenizers for multilingual text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to train efficient tokenizers for multilingual or CJK text

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以使用 SentencePiece 对文本进行分词和还原，支持多种语言（包括中文、日文、韩文），无需语言特定的预处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求对文本进行分词、训练分词模型，或处理多语言文本（尤其是中日韩文）时触发。

say.text: 用 SentencePiece 对这句话进行分词：今天天气真好。
训练一个 BPE 模型，词汇量 8000，输入文件是 data.txt。
say.note: Claude 会执行训练命令并生成模型文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can tokenize and detokenize text using SentencePiece, supporting multiple languages (including CJK) without language-specific preprocessing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests text tokenization, model training, or processing of multilingual text (especially CJK).

say_en.text: Tokenize this sentence with SentencePiece: Today is a nice day.
say_en.note: Claude will encode and return the tokenization result.

say_en.text: Train a BPE model with vocab size 8000 on data.txt.
say_en.note: Claude will run the training command and generate model files.
